# CEFAZOLIN:

Postoperative antimicrobial administration for preventing SSI is not
necessary for most procedures. The duration of antimicrobial prophylaxis
should be less than 24 hours.

# Cefazolin Postop Dose based on patient weight:

<Click here> Display last recorded patient weight (limited to 2 years)

# Weight <120 kg:

Cefazolin 2GM IVPB q8hours X2 doses Postop

# Weight >/= 120 kg:

Cefazolin 3GM IVPB q8hours X2 doses Postop
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU SURG CEFAZOLIN WT BASED POSTOP DOSES X2
